articles.title: Call for Proposals: No One Left Behind: Strengthening Early Warnings for Women, Girls, and Persons with Disabilities in Communities in Southeast Asia
articles.description: UNDRR issues a grant aimed at strengthening inclusive early warning systems in Southeast Asia to ensure women, girls, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups receive and act on disaster warnings.

articles.title: When home is lost: From prevention to durable solutions for disaster displacement
articles.description: This roundtable will bring together policymakers, practitioners, researchers and other stakeholders to explore how disaster risk reduction can help prevent displacement and support durable solutions when displacement occurs

articles.title: International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction Youth Festival
articles.description: The IDDRR Mini Youth Festival will engage young people in practical, interactive learning on disaster preparedness, household resilience, and everyday actions that can help keep families and communities safe.

articles.title: Tunisia floods disrupt capital as heavy rain traps motorists and residents
articles.description: Recurring floods disrupt daily life in Tunis, raising questions about drainage, transport and flood preparedness.

articles.title: Syria advances towards a national multi-hazard early warning system
articles.description: Damascus, Syrian Arab Republic | 15–16 September 2026, Two-day national workshop

articles.title: Delivering the Sendai Framework: An ASEAN approach to inclusive disaster and climate resilience
articles.description: This side event will explore key elements of an ASEAN approach to accelerate the implementation of the Sendai Framework, drawing on national and regional experiences to identify priorities for a future global disaster risk reduction agenda.

articles.title: Webinar Series: Artificial Intelligence in Disaster Management – Scope and Limitations
articles.description: The role of AI in Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) is transformative, offering advanced tools for risk analysis, event prediction, and emergency response.

articles.title: Yemen Al-Khair Relief & Development Foundation (YARD)
articles.description: Yemen Al-Khair Foundation for Relief and Development is a national humanitarian and development organization committed to supporting vulnerable populations affected by conflict, displacement, natural hazards, and socio-economic challenges across Yemen.

articles.title: Harmful information in disasters: Risk communication for safer decisions (Guidance note)
articles.description: This guidance note outlines practical approaches to strengthening information integrity within risk communication–before, during, and after disasters. Preparing for and managing information risks is an integral part of disaster risk reduction efforts.
